answer: Proof of Stake provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a copper-plated security deposit. This cost prevents a comet-like swarm of malicious accounts from flooding the network, as creating infinite nodes becomes prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to subvert the consensus logic effectively incurs linear costs that outweigh any potential gain, ensuring the protocol remains as stable as a perfectly balanced sonnet in its algorithmic execution.
